name: Oxion AI
description: 33 models with a 0.5M-token monthly free allowance and no card.
overview: Oxion AI serves the same 33-model catalogue as its sibling domains through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at oxionai.com/v1 — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM and Seed among them. Signing up here means a third independent 500,000-token monthly free allowance with no card, and every model in the catalogue is reachable on the free plan. Paid plans start at $3.50 for 50M tokens, with overage billed against the balance at each model's list rate.
free_access: 500K free tokens every month, per account
